notes: Startup is faster: the loader now downloads in a pool of four while still compiling and running the files strictly in order, so the load is no longer the sum of forty round trips; the per-build cache is written off the load thread; and the first page's entrance animation plays when the panel is actually visible instead of behind the loading card. Deadlines use os.clock now, so the stall readout is accurate. getgenv().AetherDebug prints the load time in ms.
